article_type: methodology / how-to guide with worked calculation
search_intent: Methodology/how-to: how Agile software development works day to day, with definition intent secondary
h1: Agile Software Development: Practices, Process and Examples
seo_title: Agile Software Development: Practices, Process and Examples
meta_description: How Agile software development works: the flow from story to production, XP practices, a test pyramid and CI worked example, DORA metrics and pitfalls.
excerpt: How Agile software development works in practice: the flow of a change from backlog to production, the XP engineering practices and how they depend on each other, what Scrum, XP and Kanban each require, a worked calculation of test-suite shape versus CI feedback time, a sample Definition of Done, the five current DORA metrics, AI assistants and when Agile software development is harder.
learning_objectives: Define Agile software development and relate it to the Agile Manifesto principles on working software and technical excellence
Trace how a backlog item becomes a released change and which practice applies at each step
Explain TDD, CI, trunk-based development, pairing/review, refactoring, the test pyramid, continuous delivery and feature flags, with when each pays off and its pitfalls
Distinguish what Scrum, XP and Kanban each require
Calculate test-suite run time and daily pipeline load and decide how to restructure a slow suite
Measure delivery with the five current DORA metrics plus flow and outcome measures

formulas.formula: Suite run time (s) = Σ (tests at level × average seconds per test)
formulas.variables: tests: count; average seconds per test: s (assumed 0.02 unit, 1.5 integration, 40 end-to-end)

formulas.formula: Commit stage = unit + integration time; acceptance stage = E2E time ÷ parallel runners
formulas.result: Commit 348 s = 5.8 min; acceptance 250 s = 4.2 min; full 598 s; cone with 4 runners 2,731 s = 45.5 min

formulas.formula: Daily pipeline time = merges per day × run time per merge
formulas.variables: merges/day = 5 developers × 2 = 10; run time in h or min
formulas.inputs: Cone serial 2.84 h; pyramid commit 5.8 min
